title: The Library
content: Has anyone else ever dreamed about The Library? It's seemingly infinite, and has a myriad of different architectural styles, everything from minimalist reading rooms to industrial storage shelves to baroque stacks to modern open concept well lit areas. I don't think I've ever been in the same part of it twice, but every time I dream there I KNOW I'm there. It's not the kind of facility you can mistake for anything else.
